$comment: UCOS-URAT-001 — UNIVERSAL RATIFICATION REGISTRY (declaration). This file is DATA and is the
ONLY place the registry's state vocabulary, transition set, record-field obligations,
precondition set, record bindings, discovery surfaces and exclusion dispositions are stated.
urat_engine.py contains no state name, no transition, no record identifier, no subject and
no authority identifier: everything it registers, verifies and validates is read from here
and from the LOCATED instruments named here.
WHY THIS PROGRAMME EXISTS. CEP-006 Article XVI mandates a Ratification Registry as the
single canonical record of ratifications, and XVI.4 provides that a ratification ABSENT
from the Registry SHALL be deemed non-existent and reliance upon it IS PROHIBITED. No such
registry existed in this repository. Ratification acts had been performed and committed —
the exogenous constituent act, the foundation ratification certificate, and three unit-level
provisional ratifications — but because no registry existed, every one of them was
constitutionally invisible: no gate could read them, and under XVI.4 none of them could be
relied upon. That is the machinery gap this programme closes, and the only one.
THIS PROGRAMME CONFERS NOTHING. It performs no ratification, upgrades no state, and creates
no authority. CEP-006 I.5 provides that Ratification Authority is NEVER self-conferred by
Execution Authority; this engine is derived truth and therefore may only RECORD. Every state
it registers is read out of the located act that determined it, verified by an anchor that
must be present in that act's own text. If the anchor is absent the record is INVALID and the
gate closes. A state can therefore never be improved by editing this declaration alone.
THE FINALITY CEILING IS PRESERVED, NOT LIFTED. CEP-006 I.4 provides that where finality
requires an authority residing outside the corpus, in-corpus Ratification Authority confers
only PROVISIONAL acceptance. Every record in this registry is therefore PROVISIONAL, and
FINALIZED is unreachable from inside this repository by construction. This programme reports
that ceiling; it does not attempt to cross it.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE. No record is invented for a subject that has not been
ratified. Coverage is proven the other way round: every located file whose name declares it
a ratification instrument is either registered as a record or explicitly excluded with a
reason and a class, and --check-coverage fails closed if any is unaccounted for. That is what
prevents this registry from being a flattering selection.

programme.name: Universal Ratification Registry
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme performs no ratification, confers no acceptance and upgrades no state. It implements the registry CEP-006 Article XVI mandates, and records only what a located ratification act already determined.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL. Every record in this registry is PROVISIONAL: CEP-006 I.4 caps in-corpus ratification at PROVISIONAL acceptance pending an out-of-corpus finality authority. FINALIZED is unreachable from inside this repository by construction. Where this registry and a located ratification act differ, the located act governs.

$record_field_comment: CEP-006 XVII.1 fixes what a ratification record SHALL record. Every field below must be

$record_comment: Record bindings. A binding does not create a ratification: it NAMES a located act and the
verbatim phrase in that act which carries the determination. The engine verifies the phrase
is present, computes the act's content digest, verifies every evidence path resolves, and
verifies the attributed authority resolves in the located authority registry. Any failure
makes the record INVALID and closes the gate.
authority_basis is the clause that makes the attribution lawful. Where a located act does
not name its ratifying authority in its own text, the attribution is DERIVED from CEP-006
Article I and is reported as derived — never as recorded. Finding URAT-F-002 discloses that.

findings.title: Located ratification acts were constitutionally invisible because the registry CEP-006 mandates did not exist
findings.note: CEP-006 XVI.1 mandates a Ratification Registry and XVI.4 deems any ratification absent from it non-existent. No registry existed, so five located and committed ratification acts could not be relied upon by any gate. Closed by implementing the registry and admitting the located acts, not by performing any ratification.

findings.title: Four of five located ratification acts do not name their ratifying authority in their own text
findings.note: CEP-006 XVII.1 requires a record to record its Ratification Authority. Only the exogenous constituent act names its ratifier. For the other four the attribution is DERIVED from CEP-006 Article I — the instrument that establishes in-corpus Ratification Authority and, at I.4, authorises it to confer PROVISIONAL acceptance. The registry marks these attributions derived rather than recorded, so the difference is visible instead of smoothed over. Making the acts name their own authority is an amendment to those acts and belongs to their owners.

findings.title: FINALIZED is unreachable from inside this repository, by construction and not by omission
findings.note: The two transitions into FINALIZED are declared requires_out_of_corpus, and this engine holds no authority to perform any transition at all. The ceiling is therefore enforced structurally: no edit to this declaration can produce a FINALIZED record, because a record's state must also be located in the act that determined it. CEP-007 III.2 nevertheless admits PROVISIONAL to the freeze lifecycle, so the ceiling caps finality without blocking freeze.
